Hi Oleg,

There’s a lot to cover with our latest Pre-IPO Briefing, so let’s get right to it:

AI News

- Anthropic signed a $35B cloud deal with Lambda to help power its AI models.¹
- Crusoe is reportedly raising $3B to expand its hyperscale AI data centers.²
- Fluidstack raised $830M to build AI data centers with prefab modules.³
- Harvey raised $550M to build its own legal AI models to reach 3,000+ organizations.⁴
- Starcloud raised $250M to build data centers that run AI in orbit.⁵

Space & Crypto News

- Kraken will use a $100M investment from Nasdaq to expand tokenized-stock trading.⁶
- LeoLabs won a $20M U.S. Space Force contract for its satellite-tracking radar tech.⁷
- Stoke Space raised another $1B to develop fully reusable rockets.⁸

These reports don’t imply specific results for investors with exposure to these companies via StartEngine Private. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Additionally, there’s no guarantee that revenue, funding, or valuation will continue to grow for these companies, or that they’ll be profitable.

This week’s headlines share a throughline: the companies laying the groundwork for the AI era are raising staggering sums, and doing almost all of it in the private markets.

StartEngine (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VX0DSC3G0yvPVKF_LP8ZX4jrW5j5c_V5TT4WfN37Jq5j3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3pYW60SrDM6TsnVvW1R1dF777GFB1W3c-X6m6mxz-zVVRCKD42_gm1W87_yL841jnsPW5xfYJW5zQDgVN1QKh5qcTwkKW7YxQNF5LdpRhW6f2cV36MqVmHW65RxRT5TzlN1W3tvJ2j2yYCHzW5xrFbc37k1jNW1qZFzn2pdwpNN3Dt3_5_R9k1W20JjsZ5KpfFlW4Px3-j4LVWtRW3WjT-x8sldsRW6g9h0f7ZBcw6W96gZ5g4YmD04VxpfrZ5bP0wBW8Vtqy-4md48jW5XDWyg8q3tdDf8kTn3T04 ) is opening the pre-IPO door for accredited investors like you.
